Birds ¶

Birds  ¶

These endpoints require authentication with a station auth token.

List Birds
GET/api/v2/stations/{token}/birds{?limit,mode,extra}

Lists birds with limit.

Example URI

GET /api/v2/stations/token/birds
URI Parameters
HideShow
token
string (required) 

Station authentication token

limit
integer (optional) Example: 10

Maximum number of birds (max 50, default: 10).

mode
string (optional) Example: live

Limit to a mode [live / recorded].

Response  200
HideShow
Headers
Content-Type: application/json
Body
{
  "success": true,
  "birds": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Jay",
      "seenAt": "2022-11-17T16:48:10.986-08:00",
      "note": null
    }
  ]
}
Response  200
HideShow
Headers
Content-Type: application/json
Body
{
    "success": true,
    "birds": [],
    "fallback": [
        {
            ...
        }
    ]
}

Add Bird
POST/api/v2/stations/{token}/birds

Adds a bird.

  • name (string, required) - The bird’s name.

  • weight (float) - Weight in kilograms (0.1 … 9.5).

  • tags (array) - Free-form tags.

Example URI

POST /api/v2/stations/token/birds
URI Parameters
token
string (required) 

Station authentication token.

Request
Headers
Content-Type: application/json
Body
{
  "name": "Jay",
  "weight": 045,
  "tags": [
    "blue"
  ]
}
Response  201
Headers
Content-Type: application/json
Body
{
  "success": true
}
Response  422
Body
{
  "success": false,
  "errors": {
    "name": [
      "can't be blank"
    ]
  }
}
